question: In a certain code language, 'COW' is written as '123' and 'BEAR' is written as '104'. How will 'TIGER' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a54860e7b9f360612df2363d183a35ed75600848046142b1ce50beb792e6f0.png] 

The logic followed here is,

Logic: **Sum of the position value of the letter × number of letters.**

For, 'COW' is written as '123'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a2f92609f86d42fab681f77bebf7365d7bf990d9c915320238d3cc2e08584886.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dd5d24f7626285600c11566b6a3afde35017a8f59b675668cc5b8269c0e80b67.png] 

For, 'BEAR' is written as '104'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/17f8d6d7506bdee5bc551b0cea688c00fdb9fa3429637dbd46c3616fd536d5c8.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b4ab8834e6bd4f4b8da4dc69b7d09161d64c48a267a2488e0b988bf1dcf4dfc2.png] 

Similarly, TIGER is related to **295**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bdc03837378fde8831b1320ef39ef06fcf84ba4071200cb64d57332ef55edcb9.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c158c3119b6ee634f466534e614df2acbbae1e3a563ca1358b2cbdc02dacbc76.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 2".**
